arguments.command:
set -e
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"

before_json=$(./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect)
before_path=$(echo "$before_json" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['path'])")
before_pos=$(echo "$before_json" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['position'])")
shuffle=$(echo "$before_json" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['shuffle'])")
echo "Before: $before_path pos=$before_pos shuffle=$shuffle"

./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py prev > /tmp/prev_resp6.json
cat /tmp/prev_resp6.json
sleep 1

after_json=$(./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect)
after_path=$(echo "$after_json" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['path'])")
after_pos=$(echo "$after_json" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['position'])")
echo "After: $after_path pos=$after_pos"

python3 -c "import glob
paths=set(sorted(glob.glob('/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus')))
before=r'$before_path'
after=r'$after_path'
assert before in paths and after in paths
assert before!=after
assert float($before_pos)<3000
assert ($shuffle=='True') or ($shuffle=='true') or ($shuffle=='1')
print('OK: one track transition via previous; before/after in fixture set')"
